# Kith

> Kith is a free, open-source AI companion for young people that runs on a family's own home server. It chats, helps with homework and revision, makes things with them and checks in kindly. Safety sits under its personality: every message is checked both ways, everyday chats stay private, and if something's worrying, the young person is told first before their grown-up is let know. The grown-up's side, Kith Parent, shows spending, reports and a weekly summary, never everyday chats. Kith uses Anthropic's Claude API with the family's own key; it isn't made by or affiliated with Anthropic.

The app at this address is private: it's one family's Kith, for signed-in family members only. Please don't crawl, index or summarise anything except the public pages below.

## Public pages

- [Kith: an AI companion for kids that lives at home](https://ai.hearthstream.xyz/): what Kith is, what it's like, safety, and how to get it
- [A tour of Kith Parent](https://ai.hearthstream.xyz/parents): every part of the grown-up's view, with screenshots
- [Set up Kith](https://ai.hearthstream.xyz/setup): a step-by-step guide to running it on your own home server
- [Terms of use](https://ai.hearthstream.xyz/terms): the rules, and who's responsible for a Kith they run themselves
- [Privacy policy](https://ai.hearthstream.xyz/privacy): what this family's Kith keeps, who it's shared with, and your rights
